review_method: Read each frozen original statutory text and exact-text source topic independently; matched named branch comparisons to base duty, alternatives, exceptions, numeric boundaries, and actor/context conditions. Checked every selected case belongs to a source-linked comparison and each comparison holds its stated fixed conditions. This is CPU construction review; Native facts remain pending capture.
candidate_review_method: For each of the 51 assigned candidate cells, checked frozen cell layout, maneuver, grounding, actor listing and set allocation; inspected every case comparison for at least two same-assignment cases and explicit fixed conditions/deliberate differences; checked three fallback constructions carry diagnostic triggers and changed knobs. C111305 pedestrian is absent from catalog grounding_by_party but has an explicit frozen pedestrian assignment witness and the law applies to any person; that catalog mismatch is recorded in candidate_reviews and requires local actor acceptance. Shared cell allocations were not treated as held-out recording acceptance.
